banner.title: TABLE 62 SHUKENJA SPELLS, printed capture p. 112 - the OA shukenja spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the table - the Table 62 spell list cross-checked spell by spell between the two passes (the full seven-level grid printing on capture p. 112 of the print pass; the compressed splitting the list across its pp. 57-58); all 116 spell names and all seven level sizes agree. The sohei-usable markers agree cell by cell between the passes - all twenty-six marked spells (5, 4, 4, 3, 4, 4, 2 by level) read identically in both, zero contested reads. The reversible markers are print-only: the compressed renders no italics anywhere in its table, so the thirty-three reversible spells (5, 3, 7, 7, 6, 4, 1 by level) pin per the print italics - the footnote reading Italics indicates the spell may be reversed. The compressed name garbles (Purity Food and Drink for purify food & drink, Enthral for enthrall, Smile for smite, the 2d and 3d Level headers) settle per the print, recorded as its OCR artifact class. The grid pins as a table: the rows the spell ordinals 1 through 20, fourteen columns - one sohei-marker and one reversible-marker column per level, the sentinel standing in where the fifth through seventh levels stop at twelve spells. The per-level spell counts pin as consts (four levels of twenty, three of twelve, 116 total), the spell names ride the column comments, and the spell descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag T62Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
